messages:
emma (Support): FYI customer reported a GCP Marketplace charge for March that doesn't appear in our usage dashboard. They see a $1,200 line item labeled "metered-usage-unattributed" — but our per-tenant token dashboard shows zero for the same billing window.

matt (Billing): can you paste the marketplace transaction id / invoice line? need the SKU + partner id to look it up.

emma (Support): here — invoice: https://console.cloud.google.com/billing/invoices/0A1B2C3D4E (customer sent PDF). Line shows SKU: GCP-MP-ML-001, meter_id: 9876543210, subscription: 12345-abcde. Charge date 2026-03-05.

raj (SRE): quick hypothesis: marketplace sometimes aggregates meter events under a vendor-managed account if the partner_id isn't mapped in our ingestion. those become "unattributed" and don't map to tenant tokens. could be a missing mapping for that subscription id.

matt (Billing): also check proration/free-trial credits — GCP can apply proration outside our usual CW window and bill vendor side. that would show up as a marketplace line but not as token usage. ask customer if they had a free trial/credits applied in that period.

emma (Support): customer says no free trial; they started paying in Feb. they provided the marketplace CSV export. i attached the snippet:

```
transaction_id,subscription_id,meter_id,metered_units,amount_usd,project_number
T-000123,12345-abcde,9876543210,120000,1200.00,987654321
```

raj (SRE): thanks. run these checks:
1) confirm our ingestion logs for meter_id 9876543210 (search ingestion-service logs for that meter_id and date range).
2) check mapping table between marketplace subscription_id -> internal tenant_id (db: billing.mkt_subscription_map).
3) inspect timezone boundaries: GCP invoices are PST by default sometimes; our usage window uses UTC. an event crossing the midnight boundary can appear on different dates.

matt (Billing): i'll grep the mapping table now — if subscription exists but is flagged as "inactive" we may have demoted attribution to vendor account. also check whether the charge type is "compute-hours" vs "tokens" — marketplace SKUs can be for GPU time which we don't count as tokens.

emma (Support): doing step 1: ingestion-service shows no events for meter_id 9876543210. logs: "no matcher found for meter_id 9876543210 - dropping event" (screenshot uploaded).

raj (SRE): that explains it — event dropped at ingestion. likely our mapping config doesn't include that GCP meter_id. If dropped, usage won't show up.

matt (Billing): plan: 1) add mapping for meter_id 9876543210 -> tenant_id: brightco (pending verification), 2) reprocess raw marketplace CSV for March 1-7 to re-emit events into billing pipeline, 3) if charges already billed to customer we issue credit and reconcile internally with GCP vendor account.

emma (Support): customer asked for ETA. matt — how long to add mapping + reprocess?

matt (Billing): mapping update is low risk — can do in config today (30m). reprocessing depends on pipeline backfill queue; estimate 2-6 hours to surface in dashboard. if we need to create an internal credit we'll coordinate with finance — that adds 1-2 business days.

emma (Support): noted. i told customer we'll confirm mapping update in ~1h and follow up when dashboard shows usage or we've issued a credit. :thumbsup:

raj (SRE): procedural note for postmortem: we should add a monitor for unmatched marketplace meter_ids that flags any non-zero charges where ingestion drops events. currently we only alert on ingestion failure rate, not matching gaps.

matt (Billing): agreed. i'll open a ticket with backend and product to add the monitor and a runbook for vendor SKU onboarding.

emma (Support): logging next steps in support ticket: 1) request final invoice pdf from customer (received), 2) apply mapping + reprocess, 3) confirm dashboard + issue credit if necessary, 4) follow-up with customer and close.

matt (Billing): i'll update here when mapping pushed.

emma (Support): thanks all.

billing-bot: mapping_update: subscription 12345-abcde -> tenant brightco applied by matt at 2026-03-14T16:12:03Z

emma (Support): reprocess kicked off. pipeline job id: rp-20260314-77.

raj (SRE): job completed, re-ingestion produced 119,800 token units attributable to brightco (small rounding diff). dashboard should reflect within 15m.

emma (Support): confirmed dashboard shows ~119,800 tokens for Mar 1-7 and customer billing team acknowledged receipt. customer asked for credit amount — matt pls confirm next steps for issuing credit.

matt (Billing): issuing a one-time credit of $1,200 pending finance sign-off. ETA 1 business day.

emma (Support): closing loop with customer now. will file post-incident note for the unmatched-meter_id monitor. :white_check_mark:
